# Toasts

A notice after an action — saved, failed, moved with a way to undo — shown by `REDZ.ui.toast()` in a stack at the corner of the screen and read aloud from a live region.

## Examples

Success and info leave after 8 seconds, unless the pointer or the focus rests on them. An error, and a notice with an action, stay until closed.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-success">Saved</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-info">Import started</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-danger">Not saved</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" data-docs-run="toast-action">With an action</button>
```

The call takes the words and the tone and answers a function that closes the toast:

```js
const close = REDZ.ui.toast({title: 'Moved to the archive', tone: 'info', action: {label: 'Undo', run: restore}});
```

### The stack

The page carries the stack from the start, so that screen readers know its live regions before anything is said in them: `role="status"` for notices, `role="alert"` for errors. Without one, the library adds it at load.

```html
<div class="toast-container"><div role="status"></div><div role="alert"></div></div>
```

### How a toast looks

```html
<div class="toast toast-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Saved</strong><div class="text-muted fs-12">Ang Thong · 3 pages rebuilt</div></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-info"><i class="bi bi-info-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Import started</strong><div class="text-muted fs-12">You can leave this page.</div></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-warning"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Saved without the Thai text</strong></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Not saved</strong><div class="text-muted fs-12">The connection was lost; try again.</div></div><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="toast toast-primary"><i class="bi bi-bell-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="toast-body"><strong>Moved to the archive</strong></div><button class="btn btn-sm" type="button">Undo</button><button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- A toast never takes the focus; its close button and its action are in the tab order at the end of the page.
- While a modal dialog is open, toasts show inside it, since everything outside it is inert.
- The close button's name comes from the page's texts: `close` in the island `#redz-ui-text`.
- Nothing a person must act on lives only in a toast that leaves by itself.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/toast.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/toast.css). It declares `--redz-toast-mark` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-2`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-info`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toast-header` | — | review | REDZ.ui.toast builds the toast from its title, text and tone |
| `data-bs-dismiss="toast"` | — | remove | REDZ.ui.toast adds its close button |
| `bootstrap.Toast` | `REDZ.ui.toast({title, text, tone})` | trigger |  |
